correctness.rationale: The exact support formula sums weighted coordinate maxima minus minima over all intervals. Centered Gaussian projection onto H_n has independent chi_(n-1) radius R_n and direction U_n, with E R_n=eta_n. Standard normal upper/lower extreme point processes converge jointly to independent PPPs with intensity du e^(-z)dz, since same index cannot be high positive and high negative. For intervals length >=epsilon, finite-mark truncations and Riemann sums give the integrated extremal field. The supplied uniform first-absolute-moment bound for interval maxima <=C(1+log(n/k)) controls the diagonal near s=t, which is integrable, yielding the whole-area limit and convergence of means. Radial substitution causes o_P(1) normalization error O_P(log n/sqrt n). A rare high positive atom yields an exponential lower bound on the limiting right tail, excluding Gaussianity for min f>0. Independent Gaussian range quadrature for k=1..6 checks the exact mean identity, and direct evaluation gives f=1 correction gamma_E-3/2; these diagnostics are not substitutes for the infinite Poisson convergence proof.
